name: Legend
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | gap filled from the audited statement: Legend Internet Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 July 2025, note 29 page 54: profit attributable to equity holders 142,457 N thousand, FY2024 115,886, over 2,000,000 thousand weighted shares gives the printed 7 kobo basic and diluted EPS, FY2024 6 kobo. Stored as naira per share. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20260929: audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 July 2025 (N'000); net finance cost, EBIT and net profit (FY2025 held the FY2024 figure) corrected
